articles.title: Top Gainers & Losers on 10 July: Godrej Industries, Indian Bank, Kalyan Jewellers, Paytm, CDSL among top gainers
articles.summary: Domestic equity markets saw gains on July 10, supported by financial stocks and IT giant TCS, despite closing the week with slight losses. Major indices rose over 1%, led by Nifty Realty's 3.40% surge, while IT stocks benefited from TCS's strong earnings.
articles.label: BULLISH

articles.title: AMFI June data: Equity mutual fund inflows jump 26%, mid-cap, small-cap funds steal the show
articles.summary: Investors demonstrated strong interest in equity mutual funds in June, with net inflows reaching ₹28,973 crore, up 26% from May. Mid-cap and small-cap funds led inflows, illustrating sustained confidence in India's long-term growth despite market volatility and global challenges.
articles.label: BULLISH

articles.title: Sensex jumps 800 points, Nifty 50 reclaims 24,200; investors earn ₹6 lakh crore in a day: What drove the stock market?

articles.label: BULLISH

articles.title: Indian Bank share price zooms 10% after announcement of Q1 results 2026
